statements.quote: That cash generation has enabled us to increase our investment in R&D and acquisitions, strengthening our future AI and hybrid cloud capabilities, while supporting continued shareholder returns through our dividend.
statements.notes: CFO quote says R&D investment increased in part to strengthen AI capabilities, alongside hybrid cloud. AI is one driver of total R&D, not a quantified AI portion. The sentence names no year; the present-perfect 'has enabled us to increase' is read as a completed period. The investment also covers acquisitions, which are not opex.

none_found.reason: capital expenditures appear only in the free cash flow definition (p02); no sentence links capital expenditures to AI
